description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pilapitiya, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320555
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property title matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
